summary: Resolved. WIN-005 cited unverifiable 160-200/80-120 nT/yr SAA decay figures that clashed with WIN-035's ~28-30 nT/yr and the dome's implied 46.8 nT/yr. EXP-582 Patch 1 replaces them with a CHAOS-7-grounded three-metric disambiguation: (i) minimum-VALUE decline ~28-30 nT/yr multi-decade -> ~47 nT/yr 2000-2025 (the dome's & WIN-035's metric, same quantity different window, accelerating per CHAOS-7); (ii) peak LOCAL secular variation ~98 nT/yr (paper's 492 nT/2014-2019 GVO max, larger because the anomaly drifts westward); (iii) the dome's purely qualitative one-bit claim. WIN-035 needs no change. Apply the two find_replace patches in the findings file to data/wins.json WIN-005, then close.
